review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new concept it defines is `bernsteinPolynomial`. A grep for "Bernstein" in Mathlib shows no other Bernstein polynomial definition. The matches are the Analysis file (`Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Bernstein.lean`), which builds on this file, and unrelated Schröder–Bernstein and other results. The definition is built from existing Mathlib pieces: `Nat.choose`, `X`, `(1 - X)` and powers. The file adds no competing copy of an existing structure. The proofs use existing `ascPochhammer`, `Polynomial.derivative`, `MvPolynomial.pderiv` and `Polynomial.comp`. I did not check the Batteries or Lean core sources in detail, because the concept is specific to Mathlib's polynomial library. I found nothing to report under this rubric.
